games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: MAX RIP: your very hardest flicks set the puck on fire; even harder ones can knock the net off its moorings or rip out the back mesh, and the very top can smash the dome glass (play resets)

New centre dispenser serve: it pulses open with sparks and chugs the puck out. The opening faceoff pops straight up; later serves pop diagonally between the sticks, or blast straight up if sticks jam the slot; after a glass smash it arcs the puck onto a zone dot
Gentle flicks and puck bounciness are unchanged
